comment: [EN] The demo list of the Objective-C example (UIViewController+CYLSettingsSection.m, UITableViewCell+CYLBadgeExtention.m), shared by the React Native and Flutter examples (scripts/sync-example-shared.py copies it). {name} is filled in at run time. [CN] Objective-C 示例的演示列表，React Native 与 Flutter 示例共用（scripts/sync-example-shared.py 负责复制）；{name} 在运行时填入。

rows.title: 🌐 Language：🇺🇸 English
rows.subtitle: Tap to change the language

rows.title: Simulate memory warning
rows.subtitle: Unloads unselected tabs; they load again when selected

rows.title: Title offset (titlePositionAdjustment)
rows.subtitle: Tap to switch the vertical offset of all tab titles, current: {titleOffset}

rows.title: standardAppearance theme (shared by Liquid Glass and FlatDesign)
rows.subtitle: Tap to switch tabBar.standardAppearance, current: {appearance}

rows.title: Skin (theme, issue #216)
rows.subtitle: Tap to pick a theme: the TabBar background, icons and text colors change in place, in every TabBar style. Now: {skin}

rows.title: Minimize / hide the TabBar on scroll (issue #13)
rows.subtitle: Tap to change the scroll behavior. Now: {scrollBehavior}. Liquid Glass (iOS 26+): the system minimizes the TabBar; FlatDesign and the classic style (iOS 25 and earlier, iOS 26 UI compatibility mode): the TabBar hides.

rows.title: Show / hide CYLFlatDesignTabBar
rows.subtitle: Not supported by this tab bar style: FlatDesign (CYLFlatDesignTabBar) only

rows.title: Change CYLFlatDesignTabBar height
rows.subtitle: Not supported by Liquid Glass: the system sets the tab bar height (FlatDesign and the classic style support it)

rows.title: CYLFlatDesignTabBarItem: not centered (system style)
rows.subtitle: Not supported by this tab bar style: FlatDesign (CYLFlatDesignTabBar) only

rows.title: CYLFlatDesignTabBarItem: centered
rows.subtitle: Not supported by this tab bar style: FlatDesign (CYLFlatDesignTabBar) only

rows.title: Set CYLFlatDesignTabBarItem background color
rows.subtitle: Not supported by this tab bar style: FlatDesign (CYLFlatDesignTabBar) only

rows.title: Scroll hiding: simulate interruptions (issue #13)
rows.subtitle: Choose an interruption; it fires after 1.5 s. Scroll down first to hide the TabBar.

rows.title: Change tab title
rows.subtitle: Changes this page's tab title in place; tap again to restore

rows.title: Switch tab icon
rows.subtitle: Shows a custom view as this page's tab icon; tap again to restore

rows.title: Download network icon
rows.subtitle: Downloads this page's tab icon from the network (cached); tap again to restore

rows.title: Change all network icons
rows.subtitle: Downloads and updates the icons of all tabs; tap again to restore the initial icons

rows.title: Change all local icons
rows.subtitle: Updates the icons of all tabs with local images (name, file path, UIImage, file URL); tap again to restore

rows.title: GIF icon
rows.subtitle: Shows an animated GIF as this page's tab icon; tap again to restore

rows.title: Change all titles
rows.subtitle: Updates the titles of all tabs at once; tap again to restore

rows.title: Replace neighboring tabs
rows.subtitle: Shows other pages in the tabs on both sides of this tab (issue #481); tap again to restore

rows.title: selectedIndex and the PlusButton (issue #515)
rows.subtitle: Tap to select the next tab. Index without the PlusButton: {indexWithoutPlus}, selectedIndex: {selectedIndex}, now: {selectedTitle}

rows.title: Login state: {login}
rows.subtitle: Switch on means logged in, off means logged out (cached locally). While logged out, tapping “Messages, Me” shows the login screen first, then switches to that tab after logging in; while logged in, it switches right away.

rows.title: PlusButton touchable area (issue #91)
rows.subtitle: Turn the switch on to show the touchable area in translucent red, off to restore the normal look; drag the slider to multiply the area. Now: {touchScale}

rows.title: PlusButton image loaded later
rows.subtitle: Tap to pick a case and push a tab bar controller: its PlusButton has no image at first; 2 seconds later the image is loaded, replaced or removed, or a background image is loaded. The result should match an image set at launch.

rows.title: Tab tap animation (issue #535)
rows.subtitle: Tap to switch the tap animation of the tabs and the PlusButton. Now: {tapAnimation}

rows.title: Tab tap sound and haptics (issue #535)
rows.subtitle: Tap to switch, then tap any tab or the PlusButton to hear it. Haptics vibrate on a real device only. Now: {tapSound}

rows.title: Long press on tabs (issue #535)
rows.subtitle: Turn the switch on, then long-press any tab or the PlusButton to see its identifier.

rows.title: Long press duration and double tap interval (issue #535 / #152)
rows.subtitle: Tap to switch. cyl_tabBarItemLongPressDuration: {longPress} s, cyl_tabButtonLongPressMinimumDuration: {longPress} s, cyl_tabBarItemDoubleTapInterval: {doubleTap} s

rows.title: Swipe to switch tabs (issue #535)
rows.subtitle: Turn the switch on, then swipe left or right on the page to go to the next or previous tab.

rows.title: Previous / next tab (issue #535)
rows.subtitle: Tap the arrows on the right to call cyl_switchToAdjacentTabWithStep:-1 / 1. Like a swipe, it skips the PlusButton and checks login. Last result: {adjacent}

rows.title: Slide transition (CYLTabBarSlideTransitionAnimator)
rows.subtitle: Tap to open a system UITabBarController: tap a tab or drag the page left or right, and the page slides with your finger.

rows.title: Hide the navigation bar without a base class (issue #535)
rows.subtitle: The switch sets cyl_automaticNavigationSettingEnabled; tap the row to push a plain UIViewController that sets cyl_navigationBarHidden and cyl_hidesAncestorNavigationBars.

rows.title: Respond outside the superview (issue #535)
rows.subtitle: With the switch on, the part of the button outside the gray box responds too; each tap plays the scale animation. Taps: {outsideTaps}

rows.title: Load images from a bundle (issue #535)
rows.subtitle: The image on the left is read from the resource bundle with CYLImageInBundle (not cached). CYLBundleImage in the main bundle: Found CYLImagePathInBundle ✓ (cyl_badge_sample_icon@3x.png) · CYLBundleImagePath ✓ · CYLBundleImageData 11 KB · CYLBundleImageFromData ✓ (@3x) · CYLImageNamed ✓

rows.title: CYLUtils weak associated objects and finding a button (issue #535)
rows.subtitle: Tap to run: cyl_setWeakAssociatedObject:forKey: returns nil once the object is released; cyl_nearestControlBelowView: finds the selected tab's button from its icon.

rows.title: Create a TabBarController from a configuration file
rows.subtitle: One file builds the whole tab bar: choose JSON, YAML, TOML, plist, XML, INI and more, or load it from a URL.
